```{r}
centiles_dataframes = list.files("centile_dataframes")

centiles_dataframe = read_rds(paste0("centile_dataframes/", centiles_dataframes[1])) |> 
  select(-starts_with("M14"))
for (df in centiles_dataframes[-1]){
  df = read_rds(paste0("centile_dataframes/", df))|> 
  select(-starts_with("M14"))
  centiles_dataframe = full_join(centiles_dataframe, df, by = colnames(df)[1:16]) 
}
  
centiles_dataframe = centiles_dataframe |> 
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("centiles"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    across(starts_with("z_scores"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    centiles_ENMOa_AvAcc = centiles_ENMOa_AvAcc.x + centiles_ENMOa_AvAcc.y,
    centiles_ENMO_AvAcc = centiles_ENMO_AvAcc.x + centiles_ENMO_AvAcc.y,
    centiles_MAD_AvAcc = centiles_MAD_AvAcc.x + centiles_MAD_AvAcc.y,
    centiles_LFENMO_AvAcc = centiles_LFENMO_AvAcc.x + centiles_LFENMO_AvAcc.y,
    centiles_NeishabouriCount_vm_AvAcc = centiles_NeishabouriCount_vm_AvAcc.x + centiles_NeishabouriCount_vm_AvAcc.y,
    centiles_ENMOa_IG = centiles_ENMOa_IG.x + centiles_ENMOa_IG.y,
    centiles_ENMO_IG = centiles_ENMO_IG.x + centiles_ENMO_IG.y,
    centiles_MAD_IG = centiles_MAD_IG.x + centiles_MAD_IG.y,
    centiles_LFENMO_IG = centiles_LFENMO_IG.x + centiles_LFENMO_IG.y,
    centiles_NeishabouriCount_vm_IG = centiles_NeishabouriCount_vm_IG.x + centiles_NeishabouriCount_vm_IG.y,
    z_scores_ENMOa_AvAcc = z_scores_ENMOa_AvAcc.x + z_scores_ENMOa_AvAcc.y,
    z_scores_ENMO_AvAcc = z_scores_ENMO_AvAcc.x + z_scores_ENMO_AvAcc.y,
    z_scores_MAD_AvAcc = z_scores_MAD_AvAcc.x + z_scores_MAD_AvAcc.y,
    z_scores_LFENMO_AvAcc = z_scores_LFENMO_AvAcc.x + z_scores_LFENMO_AvAcc.y,
    z_scores_NeishabouriCount_vm_AvAcc = z_scores_NeishabouriCount_vm_AvAcc.x + z_scores_NeishabouriCount_vm_AvAcc.y,
    z_scores_ENMOa_IG = z_scores_ENMOa_IG.x + z_scores_ENMOa_IG.y,
    z_scores_ENMO_IG = z_scores_ENMO_IG.x + z_scores_ENMO_IG.y,
    z_scores_MAD_IG = z_scores_MAD_IG.x + z_scores_MAD_IG.y,
    z_scores_LFENMO_IG = z_scores_LFENMO_IG.x + z_scores_LFENMO_IG.y,
    z_scores_NeishabouriCount_vm_IG = z_scores_NeishabouriCount_vm_IG.x + z_scores_NeishabouriCount_vm_IG.y
  ) |> 
  select(-c(contains(".x"), contains(".y"))) |> 
  inner_join(all_df_participant)

```


```{r}

# select vars
data_AvAcc = centiles_dataframe |> 
  select(contains("centiles") & contains("AvAcc"))

centiles_cor_AvAcc = data_AvAcc |> 
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

data_AvAcc = data_AvAcc |> 
  mutate(
    across(contains("centiles"), ~ floor((.x / 20) + 1), .names = "quints_{col}")
  ) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    means = mean(c_across(contains("centiles"))),
    quints_means = round(mean(c_across(contains("quints"))),0),
    quints_means_ENMOa = round(mean(c_across(contains("quints_c") & !contains("ENMOa"))),0),
    quints_means_ENMO = round(mean(c_across(contains("quints_c") & !contains("ENMO"))),0),
    quints_means_MAD = round(mean(c_across(contains("quints_c") & !contains("MAD"))),0),
    quints_means_LFENMO = round(mean(c_across(contains("quints_c") & !contains("LFENMO"))),0),
    quints_means_NeishabouriCount_vm = round(mean(c_across(contains("quints_c") & !contains("NeishabouriCount_vm"))),0),
    ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    across(contains("quints"), ~ if_else(.x > 5, 5, .x))
  )

corplot_AvAcc = ggcorrplot(
  centiles_cor_AvAcc,
  # method = "color",
  ggtheme = theme_classic(),
  title = "A",
  # outline = TRUE,
  # addgrid.col = "grey",
  type = "lower",
  show.diag = TRUE,
  colors = c("firebrick3", "white", "royalblue4"),
  lab = TRUE,
  tl.cex = 12,
  # tl.col = "black"
) 

corplot_AvAcc

```

#### Pairwise BA
###### BA plot function
```{r}

ba_plot_func = function(ba_stats){
  plot = ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ba_stats$bias, linetype = 2) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = ba_stats$upperLOA, linetype = 2) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = ba_stats$lowerLOA, linetype = 2) + 
    geom_point(aes(!!ba_stats$means, !!ba_stats$differences), alpha = .15) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
      x = !!ba_stats$means,
      ymin = !!ba_stats$upperLOA_lowerCI,
      ymax = !!ba_stats$upperLOA_upperCI
      ),
      alpha = .15
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
      x = !!ba_stats$means,
      ymin = !!ba_stats$lowerLOA_lowerCI,
      ymax = !!ba_stats$lowerLOA_upperCI
      ),
      alpha = .15
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
      x = !!ba_stats$means,
      ymin = !!ba_stats$biasLowerCI,
      ymax = !!ba_stats$biasUpperCI
      ),
      alpha = .15
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20),
      limits = c(-105, 105)
    ) +
    ggtitle(substr(paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i]), 1, 10)) +
    xlab("Means") +
    ylab("Differences") +
    theme_classic()
  return(plot)
  }

```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=9}

plot_list_AvAcc = NULL
stats_list_AvAcc = NULL
ESM_combn = combn(c("ENMO", "MAD", "ENMOa", "LFENMO", "NeishabouriCount_vm"), 2)

for (i in 1:10){
  vec1 = data_AvAcc |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("centiles_", ESM_combn[1,i], "_AvAcc"))
  )
  vec2 = data_AvAcc |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("centiles_", ESM_combn[2,i], "_AvAcc"))
  )
  stats_list_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]] = blandr.statistics(vec1, vec2)
  
  plot_list_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]] = ba_plot_func(stats_list_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]])
}


ba_aa_plot = (plot_list_AvAcc[[1]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[2]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[3]]) /
  (plot_list_AvAcc[[4]] |plot_list_AvAcc[[5]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[6]]) / 
  (plot_list_AvAcc[[7]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[8]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[9]]) /
  (plot_list_AvAcc[[10]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[10]] | plot_list_AvAcc[[10]]) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Average Acceleration",
    tag_levels = "A"
    )
```

#### Confusion matrices
##### pairwise
```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=15}
plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc = NULL
stats_list_conf_mat_AvAcc = NULL
ESM_combn = combn(c("ENMO", "MAD", "LFENMO", "NeishabouriCount_vm", "ENMOa"), 2)
PAm = "AvAcc"

for (i in 1:10){
  vec1 = data_AvAcc |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("quints_centiles_", ESM_combn[1,i], "_AvAcc"))
  )
  vec2 = data_AvAcc |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("quints_centiles_", ESM_combn[2,i], "_AvAcc"))
  )
  stats_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]] = confusion_matrix(
    targets = vec1,
    predictions = vec2
    )
  
  plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]] = plot_confusion_matrix(
    stats_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]],
    add_sums = TRUE,
    place_x_axis_above = FALSE,
    add_normalized = FALSE,
    add_col_percentages = FALSE,
    add_row_percentages = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = ESM_combn[1,i],
      y = ESM_combn[2,i]
      )
}


cm_aa_plot = (plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[1]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[2]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[3]]) /
  (plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[4]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[5]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[6]]) / 
  (plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[7]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[8]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[9]]) /
  (plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[10]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[10]] | plot_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[10]]) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Pairwise quintile agreement, AvAcc")

# ggsave(
#   "plots/fig6.svg",
#   plot = cm_aa_plot,
#   width = 9,
#   height = 13.5,
#   units = "in",
#   dpi = 300
# )
```

```{r}
for (name in names(stats_list_conf_mat_AvAcc)){

    summarise(sum = sum(N), perc = sum(N)/3520*100)
  byone = stats_list_conf_mat_AvAcc[[name]][["Confusion Matrix"]][[1]][c(1,2,6,7,8,12,13,14,18,19,20,24,25), "N"] |> 
    summarise(sum = sum(N), perc = sum(N)/3520*100)
  print(name)
  print(same)
  print(byone)
}
```

#### wKappa
```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=15}
stats_list_kappa_AvAcc = NULL
ESM_combn = combn(c("ENMO", "MAD", "LFENMO", "NeishabouriCount_vm", "ENMOa"), 2)
PAm = "AvAcc"

for (i in 1:10){
  vec1 = data_AvAcc |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("quints_centiles_", ESM_combn[1,i], "_AvAcc"))
  )
  vec2 = data_AvAcc |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("quints_centiles_", ESM_combn[2,i], "_AvAcc"))
  )
  stats_list_kappa_AvAcc[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]] = kappa2(data.frame(vec1, vec2), weight = "squared")$value
}

stats_list_kappa_IG = NULL
PAm = "IG"

for (i in 1:10){
  vec1 = data_IG |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("quints_centiles_", ESM_combn[1,i], "_IG"))
  )
  vec2 = data_IG |> pull(
    !!sym(paste0("quints_centiles_", ESM_combn[2,i], "_IG"))
  )
  stats_list_kappa_IG[[paste0(ESM_combn[1,i], "_", ESM_combn[2,i])]] = kappa2(data.frame(vec1, vec2), weight = "squared")$value
}
```
